text: 近日，四川高速公路建设开发集团有限公司（以下简称“川高公司”）达渝高速类REITs在上海证券交易所成功设立，优先级发行规模34.27亿元，发行利率1.87%，创西部地区类REITs最低发行利率。这是继2019年隆纳高速类REITs之后，川高公司在高速公路资产证券化领域的又一次探索。(上海证券报)
text_en: Recently, the Da-Yu Expressway quasi-REIT of Sichuan Expressway Construction and Development Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Chuangao Company") was successfully established on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, with a priority issuance scale of 3.427 billion yuan and an issuance interest rate of 1.87%, setting the lowest issuance interest rate for quasi-REITs in the western region. This is another exploration by Chuangao Company in the field of expressway asset securitization after the Long-Na Expressway quasi-REIT in 2019. (Shanghai Securities News)
